[A155] REVIEW READY (author handoff; manager validation pending)

Commit: `6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9`

Changed: `scripts/ci_events.py` pins all 56 carrier run bodies, retains the
specialized/sequence protections, and adds reason-pinned controls.
`docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md` records the closed residue and maintenance remedy.
Workflow YAML and gate semantics are unchanged.

Validation: `python3 scripts/ci_events.py --check` passes 1505 items;
`python3 scripts/ci_events.py --selftest` passes 931 arms. The new population
contains 243 workflow mutations and 57 record controls. A zero-finding checker
fails all 833 workflow mutations; disabling only the new comparison fails all
187 body assertions with specialized checks still active. Mutation labels
are unique.

`python3 -B scripts/docs_check.py`, `python3 scripts/gen_toc.py --check`,
`python3 scripts/check_doc_paths.py`, Python idiom gate/selftest (54/54),
ci_scope selftest, baremetal-only check, control-flow selftest (45/45),
documentation style, and post-commit em-dash check all pass. Lint passes at
90/90; real xvlog analysis passes at its existing four processor findings and
zero parent findings. Build parallelism was capped at 8. Exact commands and
logs are in the author HANDOFF.md.

Acceptance: AC1-4 are supported by the focused evidence. AC5's isolated
real-act fixture/recipe is prepared but NOT RUN. It requires a green tampered
idiom step, both named contract refusals, a failed complete docs-check job,
and both failed exhaustive aggregates. No measured AC5 result is claimed.

Open work: manager-owned complete parent RTL/local bar, publication, trusted
exact-head replicas, required hosted evidence, AC5 receipts, and cold
R219/R220 review. No implementation design decision remains. This comment is
author evidence, not a review verdict or a claim that the merge bar is met.

[A10] BASELINE REPRODUCTION

At live dev b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8, `python3 scripts/ci_events.py --check` exits 0 on both the pristine workflow and a copy with exactly ` || true` appended to docs-check's bare `python3 scripts/check_py_idiom.py` call. Both report 1393 contract items. This independently reproduces the issue's script-content gap. The isolated checkout was restored byte-exact and verified clean. This native baseline is separate from, and does not replace, the required act measurement of the corrected implementation.

[A10] VALIDATION STARTED - exact head 6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9

The candidate descends directly from live dev b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8; its candidate merge tree is 9983ea19387ff054aa5baf7bd881cd24e46176bc. The trusted live-dev act runner was started immediately after this draft PR opened, before hosted status polling. Head and draft state remain frozen during that invocation.

Full native validation and the manager/builder gates are running in separate clones. An initial parallel native launch sharing one clone was interrupted and discarded before accepting any result, because fixture-writing tests must not race in one checkout. The clone was verified clean before the isolated restart. No passing result is claimed yet.

For AC5, use the established #406 measurement method: a clearly marked never-merge scratch PR carrying exactly the Python idiom `|| true` mutation, then separate normal trusted-runner invocations for docs and rtl-full. The original workflows run without custom orchestration or exempted steps. Expected failures are evidence of the refusal path, not passing CI. The normal head must independently pass every required gate. Precedent: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/431#issuecomment-5648862274 .

R219/R220 have not started. Review waits for the applicable validation evidence; automatic merge remains conditional on two independent positives and the full existing completion bar.

[A10] FOCUSED EVIDENCE ARCHIVE

Completed author-focused checks and the independent current-dev reproduction are archived at https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/8111e42817b2bb16360d7c3e8a422c18f10bdd61/review-evidence/505-r1 . The manifest records original/published SHA-256 hashes and local-path redactions. The portable targeted-vacuity helper is included unchanged.

The author handoff's optional custom AC5 fixture is preserved for completeness and clearly marked NOT RUN. Actual AC5 uses scratch PR #506 and the unchanged standard trusted runner, as already recorded. Full validation and reviews remain in progress/pending; this archive is evidence, not approval, and its branch must never merge.

[A10] MANAGER AND BUILDER VALIDATION - exact head 6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9

All 38 manager checks and the complete builder test returned exit 0 in the isolated validation clone; tracked files remain clean. Builder measured 208/208 hostile refusals, 46/46 RTL variants, 17/17 legitimate firmware edits and 4/4 legitimate Makefile edits. Its one uncovered arm is the existing absent physical calibration report (gate 11), explicitly reported NOT RUN.

All five hosted fast contexts are SUCCESS at this head. Full native RTL/processor/BDD validation, the remaining local replica work, AC5 and independent reviews remain outstanding. No long-gate skip on this draft is counted as exhaustive evidence.

Exact commands, results, logs, hashes and hosted snapshot: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/48d22a7dfb39f2334e9c201b638c7c8e494e504a/review-evidence/505-r1 . Evidence only; no review verdict.

[A10] LOCAL DRAFT REPLICAS PASS

At exact PR head 6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9 and live validation base b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8, the standard trusted runner completed docs, rtl-fast and elaborate successfully (exit0, 2386seconds including cleanup). Invocation: `python3 -I $TRUSTED_DEV/scripts/act_ci.py --pr 505 --act-bin $ACT_BIN --sudo --workflow docs --workflow rtl-fast --workflow elaborate`, from the clean candidate checkout. The host orchestrator came from a separate clean live-dev checkout.

[Immutable logs, command and completion receipts](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/b04e05bdfafb6f0703a99414e7d604ee7d19f1aa/review-evidence/505-r1/act-draft-fast). MANIFEST in the parent directory records original and published hashes; local workspace paths are replaced with neutral variables.

The full native run continues; its datapath and render suites have passed. The isolated AC5 scratch experiment is now running on #506. These are validation results, not review verdicts. No independent review has started and #505 remains draft.

[A10] AC5 MEASURED / EXPECTED FAILURES CONFIRMED

Scratch PR #506 at 66ba210630ff7f412e5706427b3ea976ebee3ba2 adds exactly one `|| true` to the Python idiom command. Standard trusted-runner docs and rtl-full invocations both completed with workflow-failure exit1, including cleanup. The normal candidate's docs run passed as the positive control.

Observed: the tampered Python idiom step succeeds; docs-check's CI contract step rejects it by job, step and differing script line1; the complete docs-check job fails. The independent full-ci-gate contract step reports the same refusal. Both required exhaustive aggregates run and fail their mandatory SHA/shard, inventory and worker-result checks. Missing shard counts are five Verilator and four Yosys, each finding zero after the failed selector. No setup refusal or skipped aggregate is being counted as the expected failure.

[Immutable measurement, single-line diff and verifier](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/1fa64a451b9e545451b6b566424dba7302dbb330/review-evidence/505-r1/ac5); [raw act receipts](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/1fa64a451b9e545451b6b566424dba7302dbb330/review-evidence/505-r1/ac5-act). The verifier passed and raw step/job context was inspected. The optional custom author fixture was not run.

The experiment satisfies the corrected AC5 measurement and changes no byte of normal candidate 6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9. Independent review is still pending. Closing #506 without merging after this evidence is published.

[A10] REVIEW READY

Limitations remain explicit: builder physical-calibration gate11 did not run; the parent sweep declared four absent field-campaign/freshness skips, contributing no checks. AC1-5 have implementation and measured validation evidence. R219/R220 now independently judge all five lenses from public state. Ready exhaustive act and hosted long contexts are next and remain mandatory. No approval or merge is claimed by this comment.

[R219] NEGATIVE - exact head 6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9

Cold internal review R219-1 of PR #505 / issue #407, against base b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8. All five lenses applied. One MINOR remains open under Docs; no BLOCKER or MAJOR found. The implementation and measured observations support AC1-5, but the authoritative policy still contradicts the implemented change. Under AGENTS.md sections 6-7, that open MINOR prevents clean Docs coverage and completion.

[R219] MINOR Docs - docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md:1042 - Shape-gate paragraph still declares the #407 command pins absent (F1)

Requirement/evidence: AGENTS.md's Docs lens requires changed contracts to be reflected in authoritative documentation. The paragraph describing the Sweep/build, Deploy, and Entity shape gates still says their commands are "not pinned yet (#407)." This directly contradicts the same page's new item 11 at line 635 and item 12 at line 767. At the reviewed head, scripts/ci_events.py:1064 records all three canonical bodies and scripts/ci_events.py:3649 invokes their comparison. Independent edits to each of these three bodies produce the named first-line refusal; see finding-f1-evidence.json and probe-receipts.json.

Impact: the authoritative page gives maintainers opposing descriptions of the same protection and incorrectly presents completed #407 work as pending. This is a documentation inconsistency, with no observed runtime defect.

Required change: make the shape-gate paragraph describe the implemented content pins consistently with items 11-12 and their maintenance remedy. Keep F1 open in this lane until the corrected head is reviewed.

Verification: inspect that paragraph and other remaining #407 references for consistency with the three canonical entries; rerun docs_check.py, gen_toc.py --check, and check_doc_paths.py. Existing green documentation gates did not detect this semantic contradiction.

[R219] PASS Conformance - issue #407 AC1-5, decision issuecomment-5770808527; scripts/ci_events.py:869, :3572, :3649; docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md:635 - Required script population, refusal diagnostics, controls, and corrected AC5 observations are supported

The governing AC5 is the public pre-implementation correction at https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/407#issuecomment-5770808527. It requires a successful tampered Python idiom step, two named contract refusals, a failed docs-check job, and two failed exhaustive aggregates. It does not require the docs-check job to remain green or require a planted Python idiom defect. The older contradictory wording is superseded publicly. F1 records the remaining policy-text conflict separately under Docs.

All 56 live run bodies have static canonical tuples. Independent enumeration used the actual YAML and literal carrier IDs, then checked every record against the normalized live body. inventory-56.json records every step's source line and full canonical body. All 173 normalized lines were altered individually; each was refused with its job, step, and exact first differing line. The four workflows are byte-identical to the base, including gate commands, triggers, guards, needs, outputs, caches, and aggregate behavior.

| Carrier | Run bodies | Replacement | Appended `|| true` | Drop command | Drop flag | Continue-on-error |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| docs-check | 41 | 41 | 41 | 30 | 32 | 41 |
| wire-accountability | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| docs-check-no-git | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| elaborate | 12 | 12 | 12 | 8 | 2 | 12 |
| Total | 56 | 56 | 56 | 40 | 35 | 56 |

The 243 new workflow mutations include Python gates, bounded ratchets, builder gates, and the HDL reference build. Command-removal arms apply to multi-command bodies; flag-removal arms apply where an actual --selftest/--self-test/--check exists. In particular, the no-git body and docs builder call do not acquire fabricated flag coverage. Item 11 states the same-commit canonical-entry/mutation-entry maintenance remedy; item 12 closes the non-RTL residue and retains #439's seven-RTL-job content scope.

[R219] PASS RTL - base-to-head two-file diff; .github/workflows/docs.yml, elaborate.yml, rtl-fast.yml, rtl.yml; scripts/ci_events.py:3685, :3741, :3852; docs/overview/ARCHITECTURE.md:98 - Gate architecture and existing RTL/interface boundaries preserved

No RTL, firmware, build inputs, workflow files, or gitlinks change. The new comparison is added to the existing carrier sequence checker. Specialized builder/setup/sv2v, imported-gPTP, em-dash, scope, act-selftest, inherited-environment, public-name, sequence, and aggregate checks remain active. AST comparison found 319 existing function bodies unchanged after excluding docstrings; only check_carrier_steps, _mutations, _selftest_whitespace, and selftest change executable statements. Existing mutation reasons still pass with the new helper disabled. source-preservation.json records the function comparison and unchanged workflow blob IDs. No hardware, full parent RTL sweep, or build was performed by R219.

[R219] PASS Robustness - scripts/ci_events.py:3572, :3615, :7419, :7804; independent_probes.py and probe-receipts.json - Missing/malformed records and bodies fail closed, and maintenance remains possible

The independent probe set passed 1,135 assertions: 173 individual-line edits, 336 invalid live-body cases, 56 deleted live bodies, 56 deleted canonical bodies, 280 invalid canonical records, 224 unsupported-character cases, five unrecorded maintenance edits, and five matching maintenance updates. Deleted records were tested through the complete checker with specialized checks still enabled. Null, empty, wrong-type, and non-string canonical entries are refused by name. Unicode separators, NUL, and CR cannot silently normalize into acceptance. Fixtures remain outside tracked source.

Five edits across newly pinned Python, reference-build, bounded-ratchet, dependency-fetch, and elaboration-patch steps fail before their canonical updates and pass the complete checker afterward. A separate on-disk fixture changes the Python idiom workflow and static canonical entry together: both the actual CLI --check and full --selftest pass. Whitespace-only controls also pass. These controls exercise the documented update mechanism without an exemption.

[R219] PASS Tests - scripts/ci_events.py:7451, :7515, :7530, :7804, :7962; focused-02.log, cli-mutant-results.json - Reason-pinned arms detect actual loss of the new checks

Independent pristine runs passed --check (1,505 items) and --selftest (931 arms). There are 833 uniquely labeled workflow mutations, including the 243 new mutations; the stub returning no findings misses all 833. The added record stage contains 56 deletion controls and one maintenance positive control. Vacuity is not claimed for all 931 mixed positive/negative arms.

Actual source mutants were executed outside the checkout. Replacing only the new comparison condition with True leaves pristine --check green but makes --selftest exit 1 with exactly 187 failed body assertions. Replacing only missing-record enforcement with True likewise leaves --check green but makes --selftest fail exactly 56 deletion controls. Disabling the whole new helper in memory also loses exactly the 187 body assertions while prior specialized checks and continue-on-error assertions remain effective. Unrelated findings cannot satisfy the pinned job/step/line reasons. The matching-update fixture passes both CLI modes. Exact variants and logs are retained.

AC5 receipt assessment: supplied execution evidence is attributed to A10. R219 downloaded immutable blobs from https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/6fdc390cc703cb68438698329c5bc290d8a1c471/review-evidence/505-r1, checked downloaded blob identities and 26 published manifest hashes, independently read the raw step/job context, and reproduced the receipt verifier's exit 0. R219 did not run act or Docker.

GitHub's scratch-commit record confirms 66ba210630ff7f412e5706427b3ea976ebee3ba2 has the reviewed head as its sole parent and changes only the first Python idiom command by appending `|| true`. The raw observations are:

| Receipt | Observation |

| ac5-act/02.log:146, :149, :157, :162, :167 | Yosys aggregate actually verifies, finds 0 of 4 shard directories, fails inventory and worker-result checks, and fails the job |

Both scratch invocations exit 1 as workflow failures and complete cleanup. Downloads also report transport errors, but explicit mandatory verifier, inventory/tally, and worker-result failures follow them; these are not setup refusals or skipped aggregates. The SHA verifier's observed findings concern absent shard evidence, not a demonstrated disagreement between source SHAs. The idiom gate reports no policy violations in the scratch run: it demonstrates the successful altered step required by corrected AC5, without demonstrating swallowing a planted defect. The optional author fixture was not executed and is not counted. No scratch failure is counted as green evidence for the normal head.

Independent focused commands, all exit 0, are recorded in focused-results.json: python3 -B scripts/ci_events.py --check; python3 -B scripts/ci_events.py --selftest; python3 -B scripts/docs_check.py; python3 -B scripts/gen_toc.py --check; python3 -B scripts/check_doc_paths.py; python3 -B scripts/check_py_idiom.py. The documentation checks report zero findings, consistent contents, and 824 resolved cited paths.

A10's public native receipts, inspected but not rerun by R219, report 55 parent suites / 2,118,264 checks, 54 Yosys tops plus structural checks, 14,903 protocol-processor checks, successful gPTP make, and 14 BDD features / 316 scenarios / 1,515 steps. Public manager/builder evidence reports 39 successful commands. Four absent campaign/freshness checks and physical calibration remain declared unrun; no physical release claim follows. Ready exhaustive local and hosted evidence remains pending in the reviewed public handoff and is still required before merge.

Reproduction: from an isolated checkout of the exact head with the existing Python dependencies available, run `python3 -B "$R219_EVIDENCE/independent_probes.py"` and `python3 -B "$R219_EVIDENCE/review_integrity.py"`, where R219_EVIDENCE names this receipt directory. Supporting files include inventory-56.json, mutation-population.json, probe-receipts.json, cli-mutant-results.json, source-preservation.json, public-evidence-hash-verification.json, and final-integrity.json.

Final integrity: exact head and tree 9983ea19387ff054aa5baf7bd881cd24e46176bc retained; all 850 parent tracked blobs and 539 tracked blobs across the three required submodules match their committed raw bytes and file kinds/modes. All three submodule HEADs match their gitlinks, with clean status. External remains uninitialized as at entry. No product file was mutated, no product fix written, and no build, dependency installation, privileged operation, hardware access, commit, push, public write, merge, subagent, or author/reviewer collaboration occurred. This report is saved for manager publication.

F1 is accepted and remains open under the reviewer's Docs lens. The stale shape-gate paragraph will be corrected consistently with the implemented script pins, and remaining #407 references checked. [R220] NEGATIVE - exact head 6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9

This is a cold external review of PR #505 for issue #407, by the Opus reviewer with a cleared context.

- **Base:** `b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8`. The head is its only child, and the head tree is `9983ea19387ff054aa5baf7bd881cd24e46176bc`.

## Findings

[R220] MINOR Docs - docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md:1040-1043 - the policy page still says the three docs-check shape-gate commands are "not pinned yet (#407)"

- **Requirement/evidence:**
  - AGENTS section 6, Docs: "Changed contracts are reflected in authoritative docs".
  - The docs-check section still reads: "`CARRIER_STEP_LISTS` records all three steps by name and position ... like the other recognised steps, their commands are not pinned yet (#407)".
  - At this head those commands are pinned. Their records are at scripts/ci_events.py:1064-1075, and item 11 (CI_WORKFLOWS.md:635) says every recognized carrier `run` body is pinned.
  - Measured: I dropped `--self-test` from `Deploy shape gate`. The head checker refuses it with "job `docs-check` step 42 (`Deploy shape gate`) script is not the canonical form: line 1 ...". The base checker accepts the same edit (logs/shape-gate-pin-probe.log).
  - Commit 5251942a (2026-09-19) wrote the sentence as a forward reference to this issue, and this diff leaves it untouched.
  - I did not also file this under Conformance. AC4 names items 11 and 12 only, and both are updated.
- **Impact:** once `Closes #407` merges, the authoritative CI policy contradicts itself. A cold reader of the docs-check section would conclude that the sweep, deploy and entity gate commands can still be rewritten under their recorded names.
- **Required change:** the sentence states the current contract, or is removed. No text on the page may still name the carriers' non-gate script content as open.
- **Verification:**
  - `git grep -n "pinned yet (#407)"` returns nothing.
  - These all pass at the corrected head: docs_check, gen_toc --check, check_doc_paths, check_em_dash against the merge base, and ci_events --check/--selftest.

[R220] MINOR Tests, Conformance - scripts/ci_events.py:7435-7437 (`_carrier_script_edits`, `or-true`) - the swallowed-call lever swallows only each body's last command, so `--selftest` cannot fail for a comparison that ignores a swallowed non-last call, including the exact AC5 mutation

- **Requirement/evidence:**
  - AGENTS section 6, Tests: "Each new test can fail for the defect it claims to detect".
  - The `or-true` edit appends ` || true` to `lines[-1]` only.
  - This PR adds the claim "A swallowed Python idiom call therefore leaves that step green, but both jobs' contract steps refuse it by name" (CI_WORKFLOWS.md:770-771). That call is line 1 of 2 in docs-check step 34, and no arm swallows it.
- **Measured** in memory with a weakened comparison, mutant M5b, which ignores a trailing `|| true` on every non-last line:
  - `--check` stays green and the complete `--selftest` still passes, with 931 arms.
  - M5b accepts the AC5 tamper with 0 findings. The real checker reports 1 (logs/full-selftest-under-checker-mutants.log).
  - The 40 multi-command bodies have 117 non-last lines between them. The real checker refuses an appended `|| true` on every one; M5b accepts 54 (logs/m5b-exposure.log).
  - Those 54 include the bounded `--check` call of four ratchets (docs-check steps 26, 28, 30 and 31, line 1) and the Python idiom call (step 34, line 1).
- **Precedent:** the #303 pin arms swallow each command of its two-command body (scripts/ci_events.py:6657-6666; CI_WORKFLOWS.md:892-893).
- **Conformance attribution:**
  - AC2 requires "`|| true` appended to the call" for "a ratchet with a bound".
  - Every ratchet body is `<ratchet> --check` followed by `<ratchet> --selftest`, and only the self-test line has a swallowing arm.
  - Read literally ("a call in the body"), AC2 is met. Read as "the ratchet's bounded call", AC2 is not met.
  - Per AGENTS section 6, I record this under both lenses and publish the ambiguity here.
  - The required change below satisfies both readings, so no separate decision is needed if the lane adopts it.
